name: Sindhi Sai Bhaji
ingredients: ¼ cup (50 g) chana dal, soaked 30 minutes
½ tsp cumin seeds and ¼ tsp turmeric
steps: Pressure-cook the chana dal with the potato and 1 cup water for 3 whistles until soft.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, then cook the onion, ginger and garlic for 5 minutes. Add the tomato and turmeric.
Add all the greens and cook for 5 minutes until wilted.
Add the cooked dal and potato, plus a splash of water, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Mash lightly to a thick, porridge-like texture and season with salt.
note: A traditional Sindhi dish of mixed greens and chana dal; three greens give iron and fibre.
